title: Bug: test_qos_sai enableECN fixture assumes all LCs on a Chassis are Multi-Asic
author: peterbailey-arista
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

`tests/qos/qos_sai_base.py` has a new `enableEcn` fixture which uses counterpoll CLI to enable wredqueue and wredport counters, followed by disabling them.
This fixture incorrectly assumes that if the first Linecard of a chassis is multi asic then they all are and it then incorrectly uses the counterpoll CLI to enable and disable these counters on each linecard.

The test_qos_sai tests are then caused to fail because of this incorrect usage.

### Steps to Reproduce

run `tests/qos/test_qos_sai.py` on a modular chassis that has both a multi asic linecard and a single asic linecard.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Actual behaviour: tests fails on the single asic linecard with
```
Error: Invalid value for '-n' / '--namespace': 'asic0' is not one of '', ''
```

Expected behaviour: tests pass.

This commit fixes the issue and provides a general code improvement.

This fixture incorrectly assumes that if the first Linecard of a chassis is multi asic then they all are and it then incorrectly uses the counterpoll CLI to enable and disable these counters on each linecard.

This PR fixes the issue.
